_doc: Checked reference facts the radar's reply drafts may use alongside the site's live figures. Every number a draft uses must come from here, the day's fact sheet, or the post itself (validate.ts enforces it). Approximate where marked; keep sources current, and add a fact only once checked.

goldReserves._doc: Official gold reserves (World Gold Council data as of Q2/August 2026, via Wikipedia's Gold reserve table, checked 7 Oct 2026). facts.ts turns them into the reserves line and into each holder's gold in bitcoin at the day's prices. Recheck each quarter.

everyday._doc: Everyday US prices, from FRED (checked 7 Oct 2026), so a reply can weigh bitcoin in things people buy. facts.ts weighs 1 BTC in each at the day's price. Refresh quarterly (gas monthly): fredgraph.csv?id=<series>.

facts.text: The Moon is 384,400 km away on average.
The International Space Station orbits about 400 km up.
The Burj Khalifa is 828 m tall.
A US $1 bill is 0.10922 mm thick and weighs about 1 g.
Gold weighs 19.3 g per cubic centimetre; a troy ounce is 31.1035 g.
All the gold ever mined is about 216,000 tonnes (World Gold Council, end of 2024): a cube about 22 m on each side.
Fort Knox holds about 147.3 million troy oz of gold, about 4,580 tonnes (US Mint).
There will only ever be 21,000,000 bitcoin; each splits into 100,000,000 sats.
Bitcoin's first block was mined on 3 January 2009.
On 22 May 2010 Laszlo Hanyecz paid 10,000 BTC for two pizzas.
Since the April 2024 halving, each new block pays 3.125 BTC; the next halving is expected in 2028.
Manhattan's land area is about 59 square km (22.8 square miles).
A standard Manhattan building lot is 25 × 100 ft: 2,500 sq ft.
